items.title: Default
items.caption: Warm text on a dark panel, with coloured names.

items.title: Overwatch 2 style
items.caption: Light panel, open rows and cyan names.

items.title: Marvel Rivals style
items.caption: Dark square panel, bold text and yellow accents.

items.title: League of Legends style
items.caption: Small text, blue names and gold objective pings.

items.title: Deadlock
items.caption: The game’s own chat bubbles. The mod’s filters still apply.

items.title: Hidden
items.caption: Received messages are hidden. You can still open chat and type.

items.title: Style options
items.caption: Chat Mod menu, Style tab: chat display, how long chat stays after you close it, font, size and opacity.

items.title: Message filters
items.caption: Messages tab: Text only, Text and pings or Everything, plus a switch for each kind of message.

items.title: Names and word matching
items.caption: Names, channel labels and portraits, and the words used to sort pings.

items.title: Where to find it
items.caption: Open Settings and click CHAT MOD at the bottom.
